item.title: Popcorn: Democratized Fast Kernel Dispatching
item.description: Popcorn sits between kernels and users. You call a stable, reference-backed op API; Popcorn routes each call to the fastest implementation validated for those inputs and hardware.

item.title: One Layer Deeper Competition
item.description: We are launching One Layer Deeper, a competition for studying whether architectures, objectives and optimizers can be co-designed to learn deeper serial computation and productively extrapolate beyond the reasoning depths seen during training.

item.title: Online KL Shampoo
item.description: We introduce Online KL Shampoo (OKLS), a zero-staleness, hardware-aligned, Kronecker product-based optimizer that achieves 1.45x Muon's parameter efficiency while maintaining 98% training throughput.

item.title: Parallax: Parameterized Local Linear Attention
item.description: Parallax keeps the local-linear principle but parametrizes the solve directly → a single additive correction on top of Softmax.

item.title: Towards Compositional Steepest Descent
item.description: We introduce Compositional Muon (CM), which extends Muon-style steepest descent from individual matrices to composed transformer circuits

item.title: Wall Attention: Length Generalization With Diagonal Gates
item.description: We introduce Wall Attention, which generalizes diagonal forget gates from linear RNNs to softmax attention, yielding a data-dependent positional encoding that is a full replacement for RoPE.

item.title: Aurora: Leverage-Aware Updates for Rectangular Matrices
item.description: We formulate the problem of steepest descent under the joint constraint of row-norm uniformity and orthogonality and present Aurora as a solution.

item.title: Nitrobrew: Fast, Lossless Distillation for Free
item.description: Nitrobrew exploits the fact that teacher logits are generated from a much lower-dimensional hidden state, achieving 1.5-3x faster end-to-end throughput for on-policy distillation.

item.title: Gram-Space Manifold Muon
item.description: Recently, Bernstein and Thinking Machines introduced a Muon variant that constrains weights to the Stiefel manifold.

item.title: Complexity and Transformers
item.description: Can a simple transformer solve problems that constant-depth circuits cannot?

item.title: Regression is All You Need
item.description: There are many derivations of attention available. In this vignette we present our favorite from nonparametric regression.

item.title: A Telescope, Pointed at the Stars
item.description: We believe mechanistic understanding is the foundation for entirely new architectures, capabilities, and safety tools.

item.title: MoMoE: Memory-optimized Mixture of Experts
item.description: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model parameter counts efficiently by activating only a fraction of weights per token.

item.title: Sparsity is Cool
item.description: Sparse attention models have recently emerged as strong competitors to base attention.

item.title: Activault: Scalable, Efficient, and Fast Model Activation Storage
item.description: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model parameter counts efficiently by activating only a fraction of weights per token.

item.title: Sieve: SAEs Beat Baselines on a Real-World Task (A Code Generation Case Study)
item.description: We demonstrate the first application of SAE-based interventions to a downstream task that outperforms classical baselines with minimal effort/time.

item.title: The Rate Distortion Dance of Sparse Autoencoders
item.description: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model parameter counts efficiently by activating only a fraction of weights per token.
